summary: Helps you place a scale against many cylindrical drums or rolls, and hold the scale nominally on a diameter of the roll. The 576210 set includes two scale holders: one 576212 V-block (120°), & one 5576216 V-block (160°). May purchase separately. One side of the V-block holds 40” or 1000mm scales, and the other side holds smaller scales.
title: 576210 V-Block Scale Holder Set
